mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that delays Fed rate hikes, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months with UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a shift toward durable goods consumption, boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of HOUST↓/RSAFS↑ instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), reduced liquidity compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >60% of FEDFUNDS > 1.0% months, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO rising months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 600.0 thousand units signal residential construction contraction, preceding consumer spending slowdowns that drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >60% of HOUST < 600.0 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS↑) and unemployment decline (UNRATE↓) indicate a strong labor market that increases consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of PAYEMS↑/UNRATE↓ instances, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (INDPRO > 105.0), supply chain strain and inflationary pressures trigger Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in >60% of INDPRO > 105.0 months, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02.
